generator.mode: New image generation; one prompt per asset.

rights_note: Original generated material studies supplied as part of this project. Identified separately from MIT-licensed source code and third-party font/software licenses. No CC0, documentary-photography, scientific-validation, exclusive-rights or blanket third-party-clearance claim is made.
delivery_note: Only final WebP production assets are included. Original source PNGs were retained during creation and are fingerprinted below; they are not duplicated in the deliverable. Native returned pixel dimensions are preserved without enlargement.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a final production texture asset for INKSCAPE, an immersive digital paper-and-ink art installation, NOT a web page, mockup or illustration of an interface.
Primary request: one exquisitely detailed black carbon pigment bloom formed by real ink slowly absorbing into wetted Xuan paper, extracted onto a genuinely transparent background. A dense, deep, irregular carbon-black core opens into many layered diluted grey capillary tendrils, uneven granular pigment deposits, feathered fractal edges, and a very pale translucent water halo. Preserve the intricate absorption texture within the ink while the empty surrounding area is real alpha transparency.
Composition: broad asymmetrical organic shape, subtly wider than tall, off-axis energy, ample transparent margin on every side. Landscape 4:3, ideally 2048 × 1536 pixels. The darkest region sits slightly below and right of center. Multiple scales of authentic paper absorption detail, from pooled carbon to wispy fiber branches.
Style: high-resolution macro art reproduction of authentic water-based Chinese ink absorbed in paper, quiet, tactile, materially believable, exceptionally rich fine detail.
Palette: pure carbon black and diluted warm-neutral greys, with translucent edges.
Constraints: no visible white or ivory rectangle, no background paper outside the bloom, no checkerboard baked into the pixels, genuine transparent alpha, no perfect circle, no radial uniformity, no floating smoke, no vapor, no explosive splash, no droplets flying outward, no 3D sphere, no text, no calligraphy, no stamp, no watermark.

processing.operation: PNG to WebP conversion at native dimensions

asset_quality_checks: Final WebP composited on #f3f0e8 in a 1920 × 1080 frame; no visible pink/yellow fringe observed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original transparent production material asset for INKSCAPE, an immersive digital paper-and-ink art installation. Produce one isolated ink gesture only; never a website, interface, poster, or mockup.
Primary request: a bold, slender, vertically flowing S-shaped dry carbon-ink brush gesture made by a single confident brush movement on absorbent Xuan paper, extracted so that only the actual ink remains on genuine alpha transparency. The overall movement is a tall organic sinuous wave with two large opposing bends, softly swelling and narrowing with irregular hand pressure. It must feel like authentic brush energy, not a typographic Latin S, calligraphy character, symbol or logo. The upper and lower ends finish in very ragged tapering individual bristles. Extremely rich parallel dry-bristle ridges follow the full curve, with many very thin irregular transparent gaps, individual carbon pigment granules, torn fiber-scale edges and broken deposits. Deep neutral carbon black supplies weight, with material variation and fine texture rather than a flat solid fill or low-contrast grey stroke.
Composition: portrait, requested native resolution 1200 × 2048 pixels, whole gesture visible and fully contained with transparent margin on all sides. Tall rather than wide, occupying approximately 85 percent of the frame height and 50 percent of its width. Both tapered ends clearly visible. The curve can drift toward the right at the upper tip, bend left in the upper-middle, bend right in the lower-middle, and flow away to the left at the lower tip. Keep the shape asymmetrical, graceful and physically brush-made.
Style: exquisite high-resolution macro fine-art reproduction of real dry ink, restrained, tactile, poetic and forceful. The photograph records the deposited carbon material; paper outside and inside the open bristle gaps is removed to true transparency.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with preserved partial-alpha bristle edges. No white or ivory background rectangle, no painted white gaps, no baked checkerboard, no cast shadow, no colored edge fringes, no glow, no smoke, no ink splash, no detached droplets, no splatter, no additional marks, no stamp, no text, no signature, no watermark, no tool, no hand.
